name: Hierarchical Loan forecasting : A study of End-to-End coherent models
summary: This study introduces time series from the private debt markets and their hierarchical structure. Novel end-to-end reconciled methods are benchmarked and adapted to practical issues in debt data. Empirical overperformance is observed, with conditions. An extension of end-to-end reconciliation methods, included weighted projections, is introduced. We show each projection to have the best performance depending on which scoring rule is considered.
authors: Owen Chaffard, Ralf Korn and Wolfgang Karl Härdle
